comparison_rule: A numeric gap is valid only when population, period, denominator, unit, outcome and counterfactual estimator match. A nearby policy proxy is a displayed diagnostic, not an accuracy score.

empirical.estimand: First-round recipients' survey-based fraction of voucher use or intended use classed as newly induced consumption across nine item groups

simulation.formula: Grant-spend-weighted citizen self-report of new-consumption share from completed transactions; reproduce the nine survey item categories and applicant denominator to align
simulation.required: P010 v53 grant transactions, category mapping, survey-equivalent response or clearly labelled alternative

indicators.reason: The old 28-day 0.216 was a payment-weighted plan/ledger construct, whereas 0.21 is a national survey response. The registered ON two-day value was different again.

empirical.estimand: Household monthly eligible-card-spending triple-difference coefficient, recipient × October × 2021
empirical.population: KDI household/card panel with recipients and nonrecipients
empirical.period: October 2021 with comparison months and year

simulation.formula: Aggregate eligible card-like spending by household-month and estimate the same triple-difference log regression with recipient, month and year controls
simulation.required: Complete months, recipient/nonrecipient controls, prior-year panel, household linkage and eligible merchant classification

indicators.reason: A short citizen-level ON/OFF percentage is neither a household-month log coefficient nor a triple difference.

empirical.estimand: Household monthly excluded-industry card-spending triple-difference coefficient
empirical.period: October 2021 with comparison months and year
empirical.locator: table 4-7 continued, PDF p.61 / printed p.51

simulation.formula: Monthly excluded-industry spending (department stores, large marts, online, etc.) in the same household triple-difference regression
simulation.required: Full excluded-industry state and transaction ledger, monthly controls and household panel

indicators.reason: Online spending alone omits other excluded industries. Nonsignificance does not make the empirical effect exactly zero.

empirical.estimand: Mean cashback actually paid to recipients over October and November combined

simulation.formula: Sum finalized cashback paid for October and November divided by citizens receiving positive cashback; if only October is simulated compare the separately derived October mean
simulation.required: Complete monthly accrual and following-month payout; positive-recipient denominator

indicators.reason: The published 47,880 KRW spans two months and recipients only; a partial-month or all-citizen mean is a different quantity.

empirical.estimand: Difference between two sector-specific household monthly eligible-card-spending triple-difference log coefficients
empirical.period: October 2021 with comparison months and year

simulation.formula: Fit the same sector-specific monthly log triple-difference regressions, then subtract the beauty coefficient from the appliances/furniture coefficient
simulation.required: Audited sector mapping and monthly household/card panels with recipient and prior-year controls

indicators.reason: Subtracting short-run POI spending percentages does not reproduce a difference of regression coefficients.

empirical.estimand: Share of October–November recipients who received the 100,000 KRW monthly cap

simulation.formula: Number of finalized positive-cashback recipients whose payout reaches 100,000 KRW divided by all finalized positive-cashback recipients
simulation.required: Full month(s), exact cap logic and recipient denominator

indicators.reason: A few days cannot expose the monthly cap; the published 21% also aggregates two months.

empirical.estimand: Change after grant payment in the year-on-year growth rate of card sales at grant-eligible merchants
empirical.period: 2020 grant payment and subsequent observation against 2019 same period

simulation.formula: Current pilot proxy is 100×(ON eligible-offline spend − OFF eligible-offline spend)/OFF; direct match needs the eligible-card-sales year-on-year growth-rate change
simulation.required: 2019 matched-period comparator, card-only and merchant eligibility mapping, payment timing and national/weighted population

indicators.reason: Percentage change in three-day same-calendar paired spending cannot be subtracted from a percentage-point change in year-on-year card-sales growth.

empirical.estimand: Year-on-year change in all credit/debit-card sales from 11 May to 21 June 2020

simulation.formula: Current pilot proxy is 100×(ON total recorded spend − OFF total recorded spend)/OFF over three days; direct match needs 42-day 2020-versus-2019 card-sales growth
simulation.required: Full 42-day card-only sales, 2019 same-period comparator, population weights

indicators.reason: The pilot's three-day ON/OFF spending contrast has a different counterfactual, period, geography and payment scope.

empirical.estimand: Policy-induced card-sales effect by item group, semi-durables minus face-to-face services
empirical.locator: printed p.4; corresponding source excerpt in 평가항목.md

simulation.formula: For each mapped POI group calculate 100×(ON spend−OFF spend)/OFF, then semi-durable minus face-service response
simulation.required: Item-to-POI crosswalk, matching treatment period and card-sales counterfactual

indicators.reason: The current POI groups and three-day ON/OFF percentage changes differ from KDI item-level card-sales effects; the pilot gap also has a wide interval crossing zero.

empirical.estimand: Year-on-year sales change in Korean restaurants
empirical.period: 2020 COVID period in the Seoul Institute study
empirical.locator: publisher summary; source PDF in same folder

simulation.formula: Current category '식사' short-run OFF/ON spend change; direct match would restrict to Korean restaurants and construct the same year-on-year panel change
simulation.required: Korean-restaurant POI subclass, 2019 comparison, matched period and payment scope

indicators.reason: Korean restaurants are narrower than the current all-meals category, and year-on-year 2020 sales are not a short policy OFF/ON contrast.

empirical.estimand: Average retail sales change during the COVID period
empirical.period: 2020 COVID period in the Seoul Institute study
empirical.locator: publisher summary; source PDF in same folder

simulation.formula: Current shopping-plus-mart short-run OFF/ON spend change; direct match needs the source's retail classification and period
simulation.required: Retail POI classification, matching long-period sales and comparison period

indicators.reason: A broad COVID-period retail change does not isolate one two-day distancing-stage transition.

empirical.estimand: Relative sales changes by Seoul commercial district type
empirical.period: 2020 COVID period in the Seoul Institute study
empirical.locator: publisher summary; source PDF in same folder

simulation.formula: Map each POI into official tourism-special-zone/developed-district boundaries, compute matched-period sales changes by hub type and subtract
simulation.required: Official hub-type boundary overlay and coverage audit; current graph has zero hub_type properties

indicators.reason: Without spatial hub tags the simulation denominator cannot be constructed; a larger citizen sample cannot supply missing geography.

empirical.estimand: Difference-in-differences in agricultural/livestock product sales at five large retailers compared with 2018–2019
empirical.population: Five participating large retailers' product sales

simulation.formula: Current proxy would be ON/OFF total spend across four POI types; direct match requires eligible product-line sales at comparable retailers and the same historical DID
simulation.required: Product-level transactions, matched large-retailer scope, prior-year panel and full program window

indicators.reason: POI-level all-goods sales and short paired run are not product-level large-retailer DID.

empirical.estimand: Descriptive sales growth during the program at large marts, agricultural/livestock products versus all products

simulation.formula: Within the same marts calculate program-period product-specific and all-product sales growth and their difference
simulation.required: Store identity and product-level purchase ledger; current four POI types are separate stores rather than products inside marts

indicators.reason: Different POI-set responses cannot represent product mix within the same large marts.

empirical.estimand: Change in agricultural/livestock product share of all sales inside large marts during the program

simulation.formula: 100×[(eligible-product sales/all sales)after−(eligible-product sales/all sales)before] within the same large marts
simulation.required: Product labels within store transactions and a matching full program period; POI category shares do not suffice

indicators.reason: The existing numerator is spending at separate POI types rather than agricultural products sold inside marts.

excluded_from_empirical_numeric_comparis.reason: No corresponding empirical numeric value registered; internal mechanics only.
Threshold-reach fraction has no external observed value.
Derived rank or cafe rule expectation, no same-definition numeric observed effect.
Source reports significance/direction, no corresponding numeric effect in registered evidence; nonsignificant is not numeric zero.
Original KIPF outcomes are merchant sales coefficients, not citizen total spending or residential/out-of-district shares; registered rows have no numeric truth.
Only policy rules and hypothesized directions are in local files; no external outcome answer key. Existing holdout has already been opened and must not be rerun as untouched holdout.
Invented policy has no historical empirical outcome.
Placebo windows are internal falsification checks, not external empirical outcomes.
Fourfold cost ratio is from a different year's program and is explicitly not a scoring target.
